constitutionalRulesEnforced.description: An applicant belonging to a vertical reserved category (SC, ST, OBC, EWS) can only match UR (open merit) or their own exact category. An SC candidate NEVER matches OBC vacancies; an OBC candidate NEVER matches SC vacancies.
constitutionalRulesEnforced.verifiedByTest: Test 15: OBC female applicant is isolated from SC vacancies

constitutionalRulesEnforced.description: Horizontal reservations (Women, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen) intersect vertical quotas. A female SC candidate matches SC (women/all) and UR (women/all).
Applicants with intersecting quotas (e.g. UR PwBD) are matched only to authorized intersecting vacancies without inflating headcount.
constitutionalRulesEnforced.verifiedByTest: Test 16: Horizontal quota intersection without double counting

constitutionalRulesEnforced.description: Unreserved (UR) vacancies are open to all meritorious candidates regardless of vertical reservation status.
constitutionalRulesEnforced.verifiedByTest: Test 17: UR (Open Merit) vacancy matches qualified candidate of any category
